## Context / Problem
After the two code stories the gated surfaces are correct but roughly 120 ungated mentions still teach removed spellings, and users' `~/.claude/skills` mirror `examples/agent-skills/**` byte-for-byte, so every remaining surface must be accurate (operator requirement). Cites are on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
Edit every hit from the census outside frozen history (`docs/archive/**`, `docs/experiments/**` stay untouched per `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py:25-27`): `docs/import-export.md` (export/import), `docs/concurrency.md:465`, `docs/scale-envelope.md:112`, `docs/chatgpt-agent-guide.md:15,81`, `docs/output-schemas.md:19,29-31,37,40,44-49,194-196,225` (CLI column becomes `check --clarity`, `deps --descendants`, `show --field=...`), `docs/exit-codes.md:80-85,105-108` (prose rewritten as the full removed-to-replacement list, stating "each exits 2 with a hint; the registry is `_help_route._REMOVED_SPELLINGS`"), `docs/identity.md` and other fsck/doctor prose per the census, `README.md:354`, `AGENTS.md:258`, `src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md:27,282` (the packaged `rebar explain plan`), `templates/AGENTS.md:71,75,76`, `templates/rebar-usage.md:47,51,52`, `examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md:88,116,118,119,124,134,388`, `examples/mcp-clients/{claude/.mcp.json:12,codex/config.toml:13,copilot/mcp-config.json:12}`, schema descriptions `src/rebar/schemas/{file_impact,list_descendants,verify_commands}.schema.json:5`. Add a `docs/release-notes.md` entry in the existing form `## BREAKING (pre-1.0) — CLI verb consolidation` listing every old-to-new spelling with a `**Migration.**` paragraph; a matching `CHANGELOG.md` entry; `docs/adr/0117-cli-verb-consolidation.md` plus `docs/adr/.numbers/0117` (modelled on ADR 0116, the pre-1.0 clean-removal precedent named in `docs/api-stability.md:30-34`), regenerating `docs/adr/README.md` with `scripts/gen_adr_index.py`; `docs/api-stability.md:22` gains one sentence pointing at ADR 0117 and the hint registry.

## Scope
Exactly the paths above. Out of scope: any `src/rebar/*.py` behaviour, generated files.

## Testing
`git grep -n -E "rebar (exists|format|check-ac|clarity-check|quality-check|tag|untag|get-file-impact|get-verify-commands|list-descendants|session-logs|compact-all|fsck|fsck-recover|doctor|tracker-maintenance|tracker-footprint|export|import)([^a-zA-Z0-9_-]|$)" -- docs AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md README.md templates examples src/rebar/_guides ':!docs/archive' ':!docs/experiments' ':!docs/release-notes.md' ':!docs/exit-codes.md' ':!docs/adr'` returns nothing except `rebar compact` matches inside `store compact` phrases; `python scripts/check_adr_numbers.py`; `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check`; `python scripts/check_readme_quickstart.py`; `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The grep above is empty (the command and its output are recorded in a ticket comment).
- [ ] `docs/release-notes.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` list all 20 old-to-new pairs.
- [ ] ADR 0117 exists, is numbered, and is indexed; `docs/api-stability.md:22` references it.
- [ ] `rebar explain plan` output no longer names `clarity-check` or `check-ac` (subprocess assertion).
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
